title: MODEST-27 School
institution: ICTP South American Institute for Fundamental Research (ICTP-SAIFR)
level: Advanced undergraduate, Master's and PhD students
about: ICTP-SAIFR's MODEST-27 School runs 5-9 July 2027 at the IFT-UNESP Auditorium, ahead of the MODEST-27 Conference. Lecturers cover single and binary stellar evolution, stellar dynamics and observational astronomy. Application deadline: April 6, 2027.
requirements: Aimed primarily at advanced undergraduate, Master's and PhD students
